name: pdf-card-mcp
description: Convert local PDFs into standalone, readable card-based HTML pages with embedded table and figure images.
long_description: PDF Card Reader is a local-first MCP tool for turning dense PDFs into calm, minimal HTML readers. This full variant installs the optional local ML table detector for stronger table crops while keeping all document processing on-device.

tools.name: convert_pdf_to_card_html
tools.description: Convert a local PDF into a standalone card-based HTML reader with embedded table and figure images.
